title: Regen Loader Subsystem Static Attributes
description: Static attributes of the regen loader subsystem: how the feed delivers rounds, and how many rounds the magazine stores and regenerates. Used for energy weapons (lasers, blasters) and arcade-style regenerating weapons (missile cooldown regen). Durability is split into a feed (non-critical) and a magazine (the only critical) module: the magazine reaching zero destroys the whole subsystem and cooks off the stored rounds, while the feed reaching zero only stops further loading. Both blocks are field homes - delivery fields live in feed, stock and regen fields live in magazine - and omitting either block fails decoding. Belt composition (projectile_types) and the belt label (belt_label) are per-instance fields written in the subsystems block of a part JSON; see subsystem/dynamic/regen_loader_dynamic_attr.schema.json. They do not belong in this file.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference path, used for editor intelligent suggestions and validation

basic_durability.description: Subsystem basic durability, distributed to the two modules by their feed / magazine durability_weight. The subsystem durability is the sum of both modules; the magazine reaching zero destroys the whole subsystem, and either module must be repaired to 30% of its own maximum to leave the destroyed state.

pass_damage.description: Whether to pass damage to the subsystem holder. First-party definitions write false: hit damage is absorbed by the feed / magazine modules and never reaches the part or vehicle.

limit_damage.description: Whether to limit damage transfer to remaining durability. e.g. 40 damage, 20 remaining, only 20 transfers.

hidden.description: Whether to hide the subsystem in HUD, commonly used for non-functional parts that only provide damage differentiation.

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Module max durability = basic_durability x this weight / the sum of both module weights; must be a finite positive number.

reload_time.description: Time to deliver one loading unit into the chamber (in seconds). Round-by-round mode pays it per round; whole-magazine mode pays it per dock (a dock is the first successful take of the current binding).

reload_round_by_round.description: How many rounds one delivery moves. true = every round pays reload_time (round-by-round delivery); false = reload_time is paid once per dock and every following round is delivered instantly (whole-magazine delivery). Orthogonal to magazine.regen_round_by_round, which answers how many rounds one regeneration refills.

can_supply_multiple.description: Whether several launchers may bind this loader at the same time. false = exclusive binding, at most one active launcher; other launchers are filtered out at the candidate stage and honestly show no supplier when demand exceeds supply. true = several launchers bind at once, each with its own timer and its own take, consuming one shared stock.

feed.description: Feed module attributes - non-critical, carrying 'how to deliver'. Reaching zero only stops further loading: stock, belt pointer and rounds already chambered in the launcher are untouched, and the subsystem is not destroyed; the feed works again only after being repaired to 30% of its own maximum durability.

durability_weight.description: Module durability weight. Module max durability = basic_durability x this weight / the sum of both module weights; must be a finite positive number.

capacity.description: Stock limit, the maximum number of rounds stored. A loader with capacity 0 is unusable and rejected as a configuration error.

regen_per_minute.description: Produced rounds per minute. regen_round_by_round=true: rounds recovered per minute; false: rate of a full-batch refill, batch duration = capacity / rate. 0 = no auto-regeneration (static magazine).

regen_round_by_round.description: Regeneration granularity. true = round-by-round (starts regenerating the next round as soon as one is consumed); false = batch refill (replenishes the entire magazine only after it is empty).

energy_cost_per_round.description: Energy consumed per produced round (Joules). 0 = free regeneration. A batch refill charges the full capacity up front when the batch starts.

regen_delay.description: Delay (in seconds) after a round is taken before production resumes. 0 = produce while supplying.

magazine.description: Magazine module attributes - the only critical module, carrying 'how much it stores and how it grows back'. Reaching zero destroys the whole subsystem: the stored rounds cook off once and any in-progress regeneration batch is discarded (pre-paid energy is not refunded); the magazine stores and regenerates again only after being repaired to 30% of its own maximum durability. Set a hitbox module to magazine to charge that hitbox's damage to this module.

on_destroyed.description: Sound event when the subsystem is destroyed.

on_activate.description: Sound event when the subsystem is activated.

on_deactivate.description: Sound event when the subsystem is deactivated.

examples.description: Minimal example - required fields only: instant delivery, static magazine
Round-by-round example - 2A90 autocannon, 74-round magazine, 0.45s per round, 120 rounds/min regen

Whole-magazine example - 30-round magazine, 4s to dock, every round after the first take is instant; a new binding has to dock again. It differs from the round-by-round example only in its time structure, and both share the same timer and progress reporting
Module weight example - 30 total durability, feed takes 1/3 (10) and magazine takes 2/3 (20)
